episodes.title: SHAKAHOLA HORROR: Government Releases 8 More Identified Bodies to Families! 🕊️
episodes.description:
The government has released eight bodies exhumed from the Shakahola forest to their families for burial after concluding the identification process.
Chief Government Pathologist Richard jorogeh confirmed that the remains were handed over to relatives from various counties, including Migori and Busia, adding that the government will provide transport logistics for the burials.
During the release, Titus Omondi Oloo, a representative of one of the grieving families, revealed he initially thought his brother—a former prison warder—had fled to join the Russian army, only to discover he had fallen victim to the starvation cult. The affected families have urged the state to prosecute cult leader Paul Mackenzie to the full extent of the law for the atrocities committed against their loved ones.
